name: Kupu Community Program
what_you_do: A year long Oahu program for youth who lack support. It starts with 6 weeks of outdoor land repair. Then you work toward a high school diploma or equivalency, with job training in food and events.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 16 to 24 who lack support. The page lists who can get paid on the job training and help with job school costs. Check the Apply Here link for the full list of rules.
pay_detail: Not stated as a wage. The page lists eligibility for paid on-the-job training placements and/or financial help with vocational training.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link on the Kupu Community Program page.
notes: It is based at the Hookupu Center in Kewalo Basin Harbor, Honolulu. It works with Honolulu District public schools and McKinley School for Adults. They help with the diploma and with HiSET or GED tests.
